extensionDescription.message: Tracks the page you're reading so Luna can save it to your reading list.
extensionDescription.description: Description shown in Safari extension settings.

unlockedWithLuna.description: Toast shown after Luna removes a page's reading obstruction.

openingLuna.description: Temporary button label while the containing app opens.

readInLuna.description: Button that opens an article in Luna Reader.

downloadInLuna.description: Button that sends downloadable media to Luna.

trackInLuna.description: Button that adds a product to Luna Price Tracker.

findingVideo.description: Status shown in the in-page player while the native handler resolves the post's video.

videoUnplayable.description: Shown in the in-page player when the video can't be resolved or streamed in Safari. The Download button below it still hands the page to Luna.

closeVideo.description: Accessibility label for the in-page player's X button.

setupCompleteTitle.description: Confirmation shown in the page the first time the extension runs after setup was started in the app. The line break is deliberate.

returnToApp.description: Button that reopens the containing app after setup. {app} is substituted by content.js with that app's own name, e.g. 'Luna Reader'. It is deliberately NOT written $APP$ -- see the note in content.js.

wasPriceOnDate.description: Non-interactive pill showing a lower historical price. {price} and {date} are substituted by content.js. Deliberately NOT written $PRICE$/$DATE$ -- see the note in content.js.
